 │ Do you trust this folder?                                                                │
 │ Trusting a folder allows Gemini to execute commands it suggests. This is a security      │
 │ feature to prevent accidental execution in untrusted directories.                        │

 │ ● 1. Trust folder (tmp)                                                                  │

 │   3. Don't trust                                                                         │
